official path builds full float64 random-projection matrix and full z_lib in RAM -> out-of-memory under 3GB. Lean path: SparseRandomProjection fit on zero-sparse (fit uses shape only), transform in fp32 chunks cast to fp16; greedy selection identical (fp16 on GPU, per-index argmin update).
compat_patches.math_impact: identical ordering/composition to official fp64:fp16 rounding only; documented
